title:
python - <<'PY'
import http.client
from io import BytesIO

for raw in (
    b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\nSet-Cookie: a=1\n b=2\n\n',
    b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nSet-Cookie: a=1\r\n b=2\r\n\r\n',
):
    response = http.client.HTTPResponse(BytesIO(raw))
    response.begin()
    print(repr(response.msg.get('Set-Cookie')))
PY

from http.client import parse_headers
from io import BytesIO

msg = parse_headers(BytesIO(b'Set-Cookie: a=1\r\n b=2\r\nSet-Cookie: c=3\r\n\r\n'))
print(repr(msg.items()))
print(repr(msg._headers))
for name, _ in msg.items():
    del msg[name]
print(repr(msg.items()))
print(repr(msg._headers))
